column1: # platform-extra.csv — platform components that Buildroot's legal-info manifest cannot see.
# The SBOM's platform layer comes from `make legal-info`, which enumerates only
# packages Buildroot BUILT from a source archive. Two kinds of component are in
# the image and absent from it:
#   1. Not Buildroot packages at all — the kernel, U-Boot, the Rockchip
#      bootloader blobs and the Rockchip media SDK are built or dropped in by
#      the vendor SDK's own makefiles.
#   2. Buildroot-INTERNAL packages that carry no source archive — the rootfs
#      skeleton, the init and network scripts, and the external-toolchain
#      wrapper (which is what ships uClibc-ng, libgcc and libstdc++). They
#      install real files into the rootfs but legal-info omits them, so an
#      SBOM built from legal-info alone does not name the product's C library.
# Same six columns as each product's docs/compliance/app-manifest.csv, and the
# rows are emitted into the SBOM verbatim.
# PAIRED WITH cpe-extra.csv, WHICH IS ENFORCED. cve-check.py adds the same
# components to the CVE inventory from its own file. Until 2026-08-22 that was
# the ONLY place they were declared, so the CVE report checked the kernel while
# the SBOM did not list it, and the CVE report's own header claimed the two
# 'describe the same image by construction'. gen-sbom.sh now fails unless the
# added-component sets in the two files match, name for name and version for
# version. Add a component here and it must be added there; bump a version in
# one and the build fails until the other agrees.

platform
column5: Rockchip develop-5.10 vendor kernel plus the Luckfox carry set (sysdrv/source/kernel)
column6: Not a Buildroot package. Ships in the single-copy `boot` FIT, so it is the one component the A/B updater cannot replace — a kernel change reaches a unit only by reflash. Refreshed 5.10.160 to 5.10.252 on 2026-08-21 and made the in-tree default 2026-08-22; the local delta is the six-patch series in media/joral/kernel-port/. Upstream 5.10 stable EOL is Dec 2026: see media/joral/kernel-currency-plan.md for the re-base trigger.

column1: platform
column6: Not a Buildroot package, and not independently bumpable — the fork carries the RV1106 SoC support. Not network-facing in this product: no netboot and no USB mass-storage boot path is enabled.

column1: platform
column6: Closed-source blobs that run BEFORE U-Boot and are packed into idblock.img and download.bin per RKBOOT/RV1106MINIALL.ini: DDR init rv1106_ddr_924MHz_v1.15.bin and SPL rv1106_spl_v1.02.bin. rv1106_usbplug_v1.09.bin is loaded by the host flashing tool in MaskROM mode and is not resident in the image. No source, no NVD identity; fixes arrive only as a new Rockchip rkbin drop.

column1: platform
column6: Closed-source ISP/media/NPU libraries shipped as binaries (librkaiq, rockit, librknnmrt). Only librknnmrt is loaded at runtime, by the satisense-edge daemon; it moved into the rootfs on 2026-08-19 so that /oem could be emptied.

column1: platform
column4: LGPL-2.1 (uClibc-ng); GPL-3.0+ WITH GCC-exception-3.1 (libgcc_s, libstdc++, libatomic)
column6: Buildroot-internal wrapper around the prebuilt vendor toolchain, and the reason the image's C library was missing from the SBOM until 2026-08-22. Runtime libraries actually installed: ld-uClibc/libuClibc 1.0.31, libgcc_s.so.1, libstdc++.so.6.0.25, libatomic.so.1.2.0. Toolchain currency is tracked with the vendor-base items, not per-CVE.
